Run 'treenetproc' L1 processing per variable

Source: R/proc.R
dm_proc_l1.Rd

Runs treenetproc::proc_L1() independently on each variable in vars and full-joins the results back on (series, ts). Static columns are optionally re-joined. Requires the suggested package 'treenetproc' (GitHub: treenet/treenetproc). multi_proc_L1() is the original DendroMatic name, kept as an exported alias.

Usage

multi_proc_L1(
  df,
  vars,
  timevar = "ts",
  reso = 60,
  tz = "UTC",
  date_format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
  drop_static = FALSE,
  parallel = FALSE
)

dm_proc_l1(
  df,
  vars,
  timevar = "ts",
  reso = 60,
  tz = "UTC",
  date_format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
  drop_static = FALSE,
  parallel = FALSE
)

Arguments

df

Long data.frame with columns series, timevar and vars.

vars

Character vector of value columns to process.

timevar

Name of the timestamp column.

reso

Output resolution in minutes (passed to proc_L1).

tz

Timezone (passed to proc_L1).

date_format

Timestamp format (passed to proc_L1).

drop_static

If TRUE, static (non-processed) columns are dropped instead of re-joined.

parallel

If TRUE and 'future.apply' is installed, variables are processed in parallel.

Value

A time-aligned L1 data.frame with columns series, ts, the processed vars, and (unless drop_static) the static columns.
